messages.author: 083a56dd3cef110c
messages.subject: how to avoid geom_abline() to mess up my legend?
parts:
At the end of the message is a runable code so that anyone can
understand my question by runing it.
BTW, this is my second day at workin with ggplot2, so any other
comment on the code is more than welcome :-)

in the last code line, the '+ geom_abline()' option is messing up the
legend for the 'distance' category. How can I avoid that (I want to
draw the 1-1 line, but NOT to impact the legend).

Thanks for helping, Olivier

#ici les données en dur
Angle <-
as.factor(c("A", "A", "A", "A", "A", "A", "B", "B", "B", "B", "B", "B", "C", "C", "C", "C", "C", "C", "D", "D", "D", "D", "D", "D", "E", "E", "E", "E", "E", "E"))
Distance <-
as.factor(c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"))
Measured_flat <- as.vector(c(2.26, 2.54, 3.91, 3.61, 3.35, 2.19, 2.12,
2.39, 3.33, 3.49, 3.56, 2.26, 2.12, 2.72, 3.33, 3.76, 3.75, 2.41,
2.36, 2.8, 3.38, 3.64, 3.56, 2.32, 2.6, 2.78, 3.4, 3.53, 3.57, 2.26))
Modelled_flat <- as.vector(c(2.1231, 2.6525, 3.505, 3.7705, 3.5531,
2.2558, 2.1231, 2.6525, 3.505, 3.7705, 3.5531, 2.2558, 2.1231, 2.6525,
3.505, 3.7705, 3.5531, 2.2558, 2.1231, 2.6525, 3.505, 3.7705, 3.5531,
2.2558, 2.1231, 2.6525, 3.505, 3.7705, 3.5531, 2.2558))
Measured_30 <- as.vector(c(3.84, 6.57, 9.08, 9.77, 10.6, 8.21, 5.42,
4.12, 5.85, 6.61, 6.97, 4.97, 3.58, 3.53, 3.8, 4.01, 4.32, 2.78, 2.32,
1.78, 2.16, 2.95, 2.03, 1.07, 1.49, 1.58, 1.77, 1.68, 1.55, 0.6))
Modelled_30 <- as.vector(c(4.560453299, 5.942015661, 8.249533721,
9.497732053, 9.863051673, 7.129766646, 3.968864502, 5.082507389,
6.897234148, 7.688003578, 7.620873438, 5.17941127, 2.994615198,
3.736085975, 4.886627986, 5.156448467, 4.716615404, 2.877831091,
1.908180268, 2.274128352, 2.827197155, 2.783933965, 2.307594176,
1.234108329, 1.130069675, 1.207163582, 1.376461205, 1.247956907,
0.939936389, 0.446051799))

M = data.frame(list(Angle, Distance, Measured_flat, Modelled_flat))
M30 = data.frame(list(Angle, Distance, Measured_30, Modelled_30))
varnames = c("Angle", "Distance", "Measured", "Modelled")

names(M) <- varnames
names(M30) <- varnames
# summary(M)

#option générales
maxFontSize = 10
FigWidth = 7.5 # cm
FigHeight = 7.5 # cm
inch = 2.54 # cm
thinLine = 0.5
boldLine = 2

#ouverture du graphique
pngfile = FALSE # bascule T -> png / F -> ecran
if(pngfile) {
# dessin sur fichier png
png(filename = "Fig%02d.png", width = FigWidth, height = FigHeight,
units = "cm", pointsize = maxFontSize, bg = "white", res = 600)
} else {
# dessin sur ecran
windows.options(xpinch = 121, ypinch = 121) # mesuré sur mon écran
windows(width=FigWidth/inch, height=FigWidth/inch,
pointsize=maxFontSize)
}


my_theme <-
opts(plot.background = theme_rect(fill = NA, colour = NA),
panel.background = theme_rect(fill = NA, colour = "black", size =
thinLine),
panel.grid.major = theme_line(size=thinLine, colour = "black"),

# les axes sont en caractère 12, noirs,
axis.text.x = theme_text(colour = "black", size = 12, face =
"plain", hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0, angle = 0),
axis.text.y = theme_text(colour = "black", size = 12, face =
"plain", hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, angle = 0),
axis.ticks.margin = unit(maxFontSize, "points"),

# aucune boite de légende, ni pour la légende elle même ni pour
ses éléments
legend.background = theme_rect(fill="white", colour = NA),
legend.key = theme_rect(fill="white", colour = NA),

# pas de marge pour que le graphique aie effectivement la taille
demandée
plot.margin = unit(rep(0,4), "lines"),
legend.position = c(0.9, 0.4))

original_theme = theme_update (my_theme)

# qplot(Measured, Modelled, data = M, shape = Angle, size = Distance,
geom = "point") + geom_smooth(aes(group=1), method="lm")
qplot(Measured, Modelled, data = M30, shape = Angle, size = Distance,
geom = "point") + geom_abline() + labs(colour=NA, width=0)
